sample_scope: Two mixed MODIS pixels in Klaten: primary 84.469% cropland and comparison 69.206% cropland by WorldCover2021 within MODIS grid footprints; not verified farms, crop species, or 2026 land-cover observations

sample_role.meaning: Primary has the highest 2021 cropland fraction among 74 complete MODIS sample-grid footprints inside Klaten bbox; comparison is the earlier mixed candidate

sample_latitude.meaning: Requested sample coordinate; not a pixel corner or field boundary

composite_start_date.meaning: Start of the nominal 16-day composite interval

modis_date.meaning: Nominal composite start day, not necessarily selected observation day

composite_day_of_year.meaning: Day-of-year of selected observation for this pixel; leap-year validity checked

ndvi.quality_note: May contain excluded values: always filter by quality_status for analysis

evi.quality_note: May contain excluded values: always filter by quality_status for analysis

vi_usefulness.meaning: 0 highest quality, 13 too low to be useful, 14 faulty L1B, 15 not useful or not processed; see NASA filespec

quality_status.policy: See summary.json qa_policy and README.md; project-defined conservative filtering

source_file.meaning: Unmodified ORNL DAAC subset JSON, with adjacent source sidecar

monthly_table.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of only good_strict observations selected during that month
monthly_table.blank_mean: No strict good observations; never replace with zero
monthly_table.counts: n_composites_nominal_start_month refers to composite-start month. Other counts use selected-observation month, so these counts can differ.
monthly_table.inference_limit: Sparse quality-filtered indices are not validated planting/harvest dates or rotation advice

collection_version_caveat: ORNL subset response has no explicit collection version; this package does not claim its subset collection version is verified
